mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 6% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during full employment periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a low federal funds rate and a strong increase in housing starts signals a growing economy with easy monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during expansion periods with easy monetary conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a low unemployment rate and a strong increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during full employment periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong decrease in GDP signals a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during recession periods (t-test p > 0.05).
